# Protocolis

> Solid-state browsing for AI agents. Protocolis is the first universal, self-healing, just-in-time web compiler for AI agents, to the inventor's knowledge and the public systems reviewed. Operational, revenue-generating, patents pending, and offered for outright acquisition.

Updated: 6 November 2026.
Website: https://protocolis.co/

## What it does

Protocolis compiles the site instead of asking a model to drive a repeated screenshot loop. On first contact, it turns an unfamiliar web application into named, typed operations an agent can call directly. No site-specific adapter, recorded workflow or prior setup is required. There is no model inference in the compilation.

The agent keeps control: it chooses operations, reads results and reasons about the task. The engine checks actions against evidence from the live application and distinguishes completed work from outcomes that remain unproven.

Self-healing verification adapts as evidence changes. Learned checks are retained while supported and demoted or dropped when the evidence no longer supports them.

A model-blind credential broker handles secrets without putting them in the agent's context. The compiler is model-independent; the agent supplies the reasoning model.

## One engine, two modes

### Protocolis Adaptive

Faster than every product we have tested. Even cheaper than Standard. No completion compromise, regardless of task complexity.

Adaptive is the default. The engine decides, step by step and from its own evidence, how much model each step needs. A small choice model takes routine steps; the agent's model takes the rest.

### Protocolis Standard

The fastest and cheapest full-model agent mode we have ever measured. No completion compromise. Only Protocolis Adaptive costs less.

Standard uses the same engine as Adaptive. The agent's model makes every pick, with no choice model and no second agent. It calls each operation and reads each result.

## Evidence and comparisons

Performance claims describe Protocolis's internal measurements of the products, modes, models and tasks tested. They are not a claim of an independent audit or a test of every configuration on the market. The website provides current measurements, sample sizes, methodology, demonstrations and feature definitions. Pending measurements are identified there; they are not completed results.

- [Demonstrations](https://protocolis.co/#demo): recorded comparisons and broker workflows.
- [How the engine works](https://protocolis.co/#how): compile, operate and verify.
- [Feature comparison](https://protocolis.co/#compare): capabilities and the scope of each rating.
- [Benchmarks](https://protocolis.co/#benchmarks): current results and methodology.

## Paying customers and acquisition

Protocolis is already generating revenue. Its first paying customers are two trucking dispatch offices. It is the work of sole inventor Vahagn Boudakian.

The acquisition offer includes the engine, credential broker, patent filings, measurement record and reproduction kit, with a transition period and an optional continuing role for the inventor.

Evaluation begins with recorded or live demonstrations. Under NDA, engineers can run their own agents and tasks on a hosted instance. At letter of intent, a time-limited build is available for inspection.
